T.title: 4Dir — Multi-pane tabbed file manager for Windows (free, portable)
T.desc: 4Dir is a free, portable file manager for Windows: split the window into up to 20 panes, each with its own tabs. Fast search, SVN status, light/dark theme, 26 languages.
T.tagline: A multi-pane file manager faster than Windows File Explorer!!
feats: 1, 2, 3, 4 or 6 pane layouts with one click, or any grid up to 5 × 4. Every pane has its own tabs.
Folders are read directly, without the heavy Windows shell view. No timers or polling when idle — safe to keep open next to 3ds Max, games or other heavy apps.
Type to search every file name on your drives. Its own index updates in real time — no admin rights needed.
Modified / added / conflict badges read straight from .svn — folders turn red when something inside changed. Git and Perforce through Windows overlays.
Same keyboard shortcuts, the full Windows right-click menu, drag & drop to and from Explorer and other apps. Right-click a .webp image to save it as PNG or JPG.
Settings stay in the 4Dir folder. Light/dark theme, 26 languages, batch rename, session restore and an Explorer health check built in.
how: Download the zip with the button above (or from GitHub Releases). The green “Code → Download ZIP” on GitHub is source code only and won't run.
Right-click the zip → Properties → check Unblock → OK. (Otherwise Windows shows a security warning every time.)
Extract it anywhere and double-click 4Dir.exe. (or 4Dir.vbs if 4Dir.exe is blocked)
T.smart: If Windows SmartScreen appears: click More info → Run anyway.

faq: Yes. 4Dir is free and open source (GPL-3.0). No ads, no account, no trial.
Can I use it at work?
Yes. 4Dir is GPL-3.0 free software, so companies can use it for free too, with no license fee or registration. Since it runs without installing, just check that your company allows portable apps.
Is it really faster than File Explorer?

Opening a folder with 1,000 files in a new window took 0.4 s in 4Dir and about 2 s in File Explorer. Opening one more window added about 10 MB of memory in 4Dir and about 130 MB in File Explorer. Measured 5 times each on the same PC (Windows 11, SSD). With tens of thousands of files in one folder the gap gets smaller.
No personal data. It only checks once a day whether a new version exists (you can turn this off in Tools).
Tools → Save log for problem report, then press “Send by email” (or email the zip to support@4dir.net). GitHub users can also open an issue.

store: Antivirus or a work PC blocks the zip? Get the Microsoft-signed Store version instead (Win+E linking not available there).
fp:
Some antivirus programs (Microsoft Defender, HP Wolf Security, etc.) wrongly flag 4Dir.exe in the zip as malware. It is a false positive.
4Dir.exe is an 18 KB launcher that only starts the app ({src}), and it has been reported to the vendors.
Bitdefender has confirmed the file is clean; the detection will be removed in upcoming updates.
If it is blocked, use the Store version.
thx: 4Dir is free and always will be. If it helps you, a small donation keeps the updates coming.
star: Like 4Dir? Please give it a star on GitHub.

guide.title: How to use 4Dir
etc: Theme (light/dark) and language are in ⚙ Settings ▸ General. A language change takes effect after you restart 4Dir.
If 4Dir starts acting strange, click Tools → Save log for problem report and send the zip it makes to support@4dir.net. We'll look at the log to find the cause.
